crops.contains: base bid plan, Alternate A-1 plan, legend, view titles
general notes, keynotes, fence and gate reference table
crops.role: second test input (not part of the first request)

guards: G3 or any gate opening size is never inferred; gate_opening claims are rejected and the sheet's own statement is checked in the PDF text
no quantities, no scaling, no pricing, no gate or release decisions
visual associations never become accepted facts
results from this 17x11 candidate are never pooled or ranked against the frozen 34x22 experiments
live_calls: on hold (LIVE_CALLS_DISABLED present); needs separate authorization
outputs_when_run: runs_v2/dp001_ansi_b_v2_drawings/62ab61d7f255/<run_id>/ with stage1..4 files, stage3b visual association checks, run_record.json (parameters, hashes, telemetry)

planned_request_first.why: fast completed streaming diagnostic (17 s) and a model on which only documented parameters are needed; no ranking implied

planned_request_second_NOT_AUTHORIZED.note: identical crop, prompt, json_mode, max_tokens and limits; comparable only if it needs no undocumented parameter (earlier Qwen runs needed chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false to finish in time; if used, the pair is labelled non-equivalent)

purpose: Test whether a vision model can associate C101 drawn features (views, fence types, gate tags, detail callouts) with the right places, with every claim checked against the PDF itself. A single-sample feasibility test, not a benchmark.
separate_later_tests: F501/F502 detail identification from the detail sheets (pages 4 and 5)
Addendum 01 read as its own controlling document, never merged into Rev 0 evidence (doc dp001_addendum_01_ansi_b_pkg)

validator_configuration.accepted_fact_rule: observed claim + verbatim quote in PDF text layer + value inside quote + PDF-derived position inside the crop
validator_configuration.forbidden: gate opening sizes, any measured/scaled length, quantities, counts of fence, price (REJECTED_FORBIDDEN_INFERENCE)
validator_configuration.visual_claim_rule: CONFIRMED only when the PDF text layer places the cited anchor text in the claimed zone; fence-type and other drawn relations stay NOT_VERIFIABLE_FROM_PDF
